reviewerOrPass: Worker A, same AI, separate source-first pass
method: Reread the adopted degree requirements, dated prerequisites and the active workbook before challenging the feasibility and disciplinary coverage of the strongest trials and comparing the result with the frozen exception.
findings: The standard September 2026 degree includes 150 EC in the Physics major and a 30 EC minor. Complex Analysis follows first-year calculus. Biomaterials requires two courses absent from the ordinary Physics first year. The standard research-project threshold is 150 EC, with the conditional third-year 135 EC route described in Appendix IV.

Sustainability Essentials I and II directly contribute introductory mechanics, thermodynamics, waves and spectroscopy. Energy systems, geophysics and robotics apply physical principles. Quantitative methods add depth in modelling and image analysis. Even the feasible combination does not establish the cumulative mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum and experimental physics sequence that underpins the advanced physics work. The biomedical trial shifts the emphasis toward anatomy, digital images and modelling and leaves the same disciplinary gap.

Both trials satisfy the actual offerings and prerequisites, including Digital Image Processing in the second term. The 25-component external-only record preserves the verified 180 EC and gives an audience-facing explanation of the substantive gap.
